grasp_model.model: contact-gated exact local no-slip constraint on configured actual Franka hand or finger links

final_metrics.model: local finite-capacity porous-sheet reservoir / split SPH-PBD coupling

cloth_contact_model.model: single-cloth particle shell, scene-local radius override

cloth_config.material_description: plush_cotton PDF reference: 180 g/m2 planar woven-cotton approximation with directional finite-extension limits and physical dihedral bending; not experimentally calibrated.

model.model: PDF-referenced cotton membrane, dihedral bending and local damping

membrane.model: tension-only finite extension of existing woven-cloth mesh edges
membrane.material_axes: original horizontal cloth X=warp, Y=weft; other edges=bias
membrane.solver: inverse-mass-weighted in-place projections on disjoint edge colors
membrane.coupled_constraint_residual: finite sweeps and later bending/contact may exceed bounds; inspect measure()

bending.solver: in-place inverse-mass-weighted Gauss-Seidel on disjoint four-node hinge colors
bending.reference_numerical_difference: Sequential disjoint hinge colors replace source-archive summed Jacobi to suppress fine-grid checkerboard amplification; energy, rigidity, relaxation and iteration count unchanged
bending.multiplier_reset: once per simulation substep by material_response
bending.flat_angle_gradient: finite analytic gradient; atan2 signed angle

mass.model: native uniform dry masses from areal density, unchanged by this adapter

internal_damping.model: mass-weighted best-fit rigid-motion residual velocity damping
internal_damping.integration: v = v_rigid + exp(-rate*substep_dt)*(v-v_rigid), once per native substep
internal_damping.fit_scope: current free and active particles only; fixed velocities untouched
internal_damping.linear_and_angular_momentum_preserved: free set, within inertia rank tolerance and native velocity rounding
internal_damping.degenerate_geometry: symmetric eigensolve pseudoinverse; point/line configurations supported
internal_damping.gpu_reductions_and_inertia_precision: float64, centered local positions, no CPU sync in apply
internal_damping.diagnostics: last-pass free kinetic energies and momenta measured before/after rounded native velocity writes
limitations: Does not damp a rigid swing or rotation of the free set.
Does not prevent energy injected by constraints, contact, attachments or position rounding.
Use as an alternative to, not an undisclosed addition to, the edge-axial internal damping model.
Requires integrated velocity preservation through subsequent position-based reconstruction.

air_drag.area_model: one third of each incident physical rest triangle area
air_drag.scope: free cotton particles only; native force divided by current native mass

linear_drag.integration: v *= exp(-rate*substep_dt), after internal damping and before native forces
linear_drag.scope: free cotton particles only; SPH and rigid bodies unchanged
linear_drag.difference_from_pdf: PDF full-scene drag is intentionally restricted to cotton

velocity_update.model: integrated prediction plus constraint-displacement velocity update
velocity_update.capture: after existing native external-force and position-integration kernel each substep
velocity_update.particle_order: cache original indices; read projected positions via particles_ng.reordered_idx
velocity_update.fixed_particles: no special velocity clamp; preserve native predicted motion and any existing projection
velocity_update.cache_reset: overwritten each substep, including first build warmup and after scene restore
limitations: Does not correct rounding of absolute positions during integration or constraint projection.
Later rigid-contact or attachment kernels may independently reconstruct velocity from world positions.
Does not guarantee energy monotonicity, eliminate physical motion, or validate all constraint/contact errors.

bending_damping.model: passive implicit local signed-dihedral velocity dashpots
bending_damping.integration: one sequential colored implicit velocity pass per native substep
bending_damping.diagnostics: last-pass algebraic impulse/work ledger, not an independent measurement of rounded native kinetic energy
